dedupe_keys.name: arera technical quality regulation of the italian water service first analysis 2018 and 2019 rqti

description: This press release presents the first analysis under ARERA's technical quality regulation of the integrated water service, RQTI, introduced in 2017 to 2018, using data from 203 operators that together cover 84 percent of Italy's population. Operators were assessed on six macro-indicators: water losses, service interruptions, quality of supplied water, adequacy of the sewer system, quality of treated water and sludge disposal, with interruptions excluded from incentives in the first two years. Rewards were about 63.2 million euro for 2018 and 72.16 million for 2019 against penalties of 3.9 and 5.9 million, in base, advanced and excellence levels, and 26 operators took the 66 top positions, with only three podium places in the South and Islands, which the regulator calls the water divide. Coverage: national, two performance years, operator level. Access: a free web page with a link to the resolution; the licence is not stated. Caveats: a press summary of results, without the operator data table on this page. It supports incentive design, loss reduction and investment planning studies, and relates to the ARERA water contractual quality data by operator record in the catalogue.
